Save a PHW chart

Source: R/ggplot.R
phw_save.Rd

A wrapper around ggplot2::ggsave() with sensible defaults for PHW outputs. It saves at 16 x 10 cm and 300 dpi, uses 'ragg' for PNG so the bundled Ubuntu font works, and accepts plots made with phw_finalise().

Usage

phw_save(
  plot = ggplot2::last_plot(),
  filename,
  width = 16,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot or the result of phw_finalise().

filename

File name. The extension (.png, .svg, .pdf, .jpeg) picks the format.

width, height, units

Size. Defaults to 16 x 10 cm, which fits an A4 Word page with standard margins.

dpi

Resolution for raster formats.

bg

Background colour. Use "transparent" for overlays.

device

Override the graphics device that the extension picks.

...

Passed to ggplot2::ggsave().

Value

The file name, invisibly.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_phw()
f <- phw_save(p, tempfile(fileext = ".png"))
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE

# Wider, for a slide
phw_save(p, tempfile(fileext = ".png"), width = 25, height = 12)
